method: python requests, one GET per page, robots.txt respected (RFC 9309), 4 s between requests to a host, User-Agent: ECI-RealCorpus/0.1 (ground truth for an open-source competitive-intelligence tool; +https://github.com/SamJ12138/AI-E-commerce-Competitive-Intelligence-Tool)
notes: Product prices are not in the static HTML text (no h1, no JSON-LD, no visible price); they are in the page's product JSON (price_min / price_max in cents, compare_at_price_max 0). Navigation links are rendered by JavaScript (65 <a> tags on a 1.9 MB homepage). Ground truth price = lowest variant price; any variant price in the range counts as a match.

free_shipping_threshold.evidence: Free shipping on orders $100+* ... free ground shipping on all orders over $100 (lower 48)

return_days.evidence: Most of our products can be returned or exchanged within 365 days

free_returns.evidence: All returns are subject to a $9.95 return fee deducted from your refund amount

payment_methods.evidence: homepage <script id="apple-pay-shop-capabilities"> supportedNetworks [visa, masterCard, discover, amex, elo, jcb] (Apple Pay merchant config; the same list on all four Shopify stores); product page <link rel="buy" payment="dev.shopify.shop_pay com.google.pay dev.shopify.card">; <meta id="in-context-paypal-metadata" data-venmo-supported="true">. No payment icons on the pages read.
